title: abrahamaiproject-bit/atlas-dispatch-service
body:
# atlas-dispatch-service

Dispatch and job assignment service for **Project Atlas**. It takes optimized routes from the routing engine, assigns them to drivers, and publishes them to the driver mobile app.

## Owner
Joe Smith (VP of Engineering)

## Notes
- Caused the October 9 outage (an expired TLS certificate on the internal queue). See the postmortem in Notion.
- Planned migration to Kafka for dispatch events in Q1.

## Running locally
```bash
make up
make test
```
